text.tspan: AIcoach finds address, top and impact in your

the moment it came from, with one drill and one
mobility exercise to take back to the range.
For golfers between +2 and 15 handicap who practise at the
range with a phone. Practice tool, not for competitive rounds.

Where should I look in the video?

text.tspan: Look at impact. Your hips sit 7% of body height past the
dashed line they started on at address.

svg.text: Should I change my grip as well?

text.tspan: I didn’t measure your grip in this clip, so I can’t tell you.
Stick with the wall drill, and ask a coach about grip.
